OR-E1.Description:
Establish the runnable foundation for the single-vendor Oriflame Pakistan Referral Store: FastAPI backend with layered structure, typed configuration, Supabase PostgreSQL (POSTGRES_URL) + Alembic, Next.js App Router frontend, test harnesses, and CI. No catalogue, storefront, referral, or admin features are implemented in this epic.

SCOPE:
- Repository hygiene: .gitignore, .env.example, README, tooling pins
- Typed settings (Pydantic Settings) behind a lightweight ConfigProvider interface
- FastAPI app skeleton (routers / services / repositories / models / integrations layout), health endpoints, CORS, structured logging
- SQLAlchemy 2.x session and Alembic initialised against the Supabase PostgreSQL database via POSTGRES_URL
- Next.js App Router scaffold (TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui) with a typed, Zod-validated API client
- Frontend-to-backend connectivity proven end to end
- Test harnesses: pytest (real PostgreSQL), Vitest, Playwright
- CI pipeline running backend and frontend verification gates

OUT OF SCOPE:
- Multi-tenancy, vendor management, subscription billing, multi-vendor features
- Catalogue tables, sync, storefront pages, referral handoff, admin area (later epics)
- Redis or background jobs

REFERENCE DOCS:
- AGENT.md
- backend/AGENT.md
- frontend/AGENT.md
- infrastructure/AGENT.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/ENGINEERING-STANDARDS.md
- docs/DATABASE.md
- docs/REFERRAL.md (configuration section only)
- docs/EXECUTION-RULES.md

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- The site runs locally using documented commands (docs/guidence/try-it-locally.md)
- Frontend and FastAPI backend communicate successfully
- PostgreSQL schema is managed by Alembic (alembic upgrade head succeeds on an empty database)
- Referral configuration is loaded from server-side environment variables via typed settings; nothing is exposed to the browser
- .env is git-ignored; only .env.example is committed
- Backend gate passes: uv run ruff check backend && uv run ruff format backend && uv run mypy backend && uv run pytest
- Frontend gate passes: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
- CI is green on the epic PR

OR-E1.Summary: Repository init: git hygiene, env template, tooling pins
OR-E1.Description:
Initialise the repository with ignore rules, a documented environment template, and pinned tooling so every later task starts from a reproducible base.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Inspect OriflameMK first; preserve all existing AGENT.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/, .claude/, .github/ files
- Connect the existing local folder to GitHub repo naqsh/Oriflame_MK (public, default branch main containing only LICENSE): git init (if not already a repository); git remote add origin https://github.com/naqsh/Oriflame_MK.git; git fetch origin; git checkout -b main origin/main (keeps local untracked docs, brings in LICENSE). Do not clone over the folder. Before the first commit, run git status and confirm .env is NOT listed. Create integration branch epic/autonomus-implementation from main and epic branch epic/E1-project-scaffold; push both with -u
- .gitignore: .env, .env.*, !.env.example, __pycache__/, .venv/, .mypy_cache/, .ruff_cache/, .pytest_cache/, coverage outputs, node_modules/, .next/, playwright-report/, test-results/
- .env.example with exactly the documented variables: POSTGRES_URL, APP_ENV, CORS_ORIGINS, ORIFLAME_COUNTRY=PK, ORIFLAME_CONSULTANT_CODE= (empty), ORIFLAME_REFERRAL_URL= (empty), ORIFLAME_REFERRAL_METHOD=official_url; plus NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 for the frontend (public, non-secret)
- pyproject.toml managed by uv: Python >=3.12; ruff (incl. isort rules, known-first-party = ["backend"]) and mypy (strict) configuration
- .nvmrc pinning Node.js LTS

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Repository / Tooling
DEPENDENCIES: none

TESTING CRITERIA:
- git status shows .env ignored when created locally; .env.example tracked
- uv sync succeeds on a clean checkout
- No real consultant code, referral URL, or credentials appear anywhere in tracked files (grep check)

EDGE CASES:
- Repository already initialised: do not re-init or rewrite history; only add missing files
- origin already set to a different URL: stop and ask before changing it
- Remote main gains files that conflict with local docs: stop and ask; never force-push or overwrite LICENSE
- Repository is public: grep staged files for secrets (POSTGRES_URL value, consultant code) before every push
- Existing .gitignore: merge entries, do not overwrite
- Never commit a populated .env even if one exists locally
- Only NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL may use the NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix; the consultant code must never be prefixed

Load all backend configuration through one validated Pydantic Settings class consumed via a lightweight ConfigProvider interface, with environment variables as the only MVP provider.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- backend/app/core/config.py: Settings(BaseSettings) with postgres_url (SecretStr read from POSTGRES_URL — the Supabase connection string; scheme normalised to postgresql+psycopg, sslmode=require for Supabase hosts), app_env (Literal development/test/production), cors_origins (list[str]), oriflame_country (default PK), oriflame_consultant_code (str | None), oriflame_referral_url (HttpUrl | None), oriflame_referral_method (Literal official_url/manual_code)
- Validator: when oriflame_referral_url is set it must be https and its host must be in an allow-list constant of official Oriflame hosts (allow-list values confirmed with owner; documented in docs/REFERRAL.md)
- Validator: oriflame_referral_method=manual_code requires oriflame_consultant_code
- ConfigProvider Protocol exposing get_settings() / referral config accessor; EnvConfigProvider implementation; FastAPI dependency get_config_provider()
- Settings instantiated once and cached (lru_cache); no os.environ reads anywhere else
- Do NOT build a settings database or admin edit UI

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-001

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Unit tests: valid config loads; empty referral values allowed in development
- Referral URL with non-https scheme or non-allow-listed host raises ValidationError
- manual_code without consultant code raises ValidationError
- Settings repr/logging never includes the consultant code (SecretStr or excluded from repr)
- Single-vendor configuration test: services resolve config only through ConfigProvider

EDGE CASES:
- Missing POSTGRES_URL: fail fast at startup with a clear message (no secret values in the message)
- CORS_ORIGINS given as comma-separated string or JSON list: both parsed
- APP_ENV=production with empty referral config: startup succeeds but referral status reports 'not configured' (handoff disabled later in OR-E4), never a guessed URL
- Unknown ORIFLAME_REFERRAL_METHOD value: rejected

OR-E1.Summary: FastAPI application skeleton with layered structure
OR-E1.Description:
Create the FastAPI app with the documented layered layout, health endpoints, narrow CORS, structured logging, and safe error handling.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- Create backend/app/ tree per backend/AGENT.md: api/v1/endpoints/, core/ (config.py, logging.py, security.py), db/, models/, schemas/, repositories/, services/, integrations/oriflame/, main.py (empty packages get __init__.py only — no placeholder logic)
- main.py: create_app() factory; include api/v1 router under /api/v1
- GET /health (liveness) and GET /health/ready (checks DB connectivity) returning typed Pydantic responses
- CORSMiddleware restricted to Settings.cors_origins; no wildcard with credentials
- core/logging.py: structlog JSON to stdout; request-id middleware (accept X-Request-ID or generate), request_completed log with method, path, status, duration_ms
- Exception handlers returning safe, non-leaky JSON errors; details logged server-side with request id
- Use fastapi.status constants throughout

EFFORT: M (6 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-002

TESTING CRITERIA:
- httpx tests: /health returns 200; /health/ready returns 200 with DB up and 503 with DB unreachable
- CORS preflight from an allowed origin succeeds; from a disallowed origin gets no CORS headers
- Unhandled error returns generic message and includes request id header; stack trace not in response body
- X-Request-ID echoed back when supplied

EDGE CASES:
- Malformed X-Request-ID (too long / invalid chars): replaced with a generated id
- DB timeout in readiness check: bounded timeout, returns 503 rather than hanging
- Logs must never include the consultant code or POSTGRES_URL credentials

Wire SQLAlchemy 2.x to the Supabase PostgreSQL database (POSTGRES_URL) and initialise Alembic so every future schema change ships as a migration.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- backend/app/db/session.py: engine from Settings.postgres_url (postgresql+psycopg), sessionmaker, FastAPI dependency get_db() with proper close/rollback; small pool (pool_size 5, max_overflow 5, pool_pre_ping=True) suited to Supabase connection limits
- backend/app/models/base.py: typed DeclarativeBase with naming convention for constraints/indexes (stable migration names)
- alembic.ini at repo root; backend/alembic/env.py reading POSTGRES_URL from Settings (not hardcoded) and target_metadata from Base; include_name filter excludes Supabase-managed schemas (auth, storage, realtime, extensions, graphql, vault, supabase_*) so autogenerate never drops them
- Baseline revision 001_baseline (no business tables — catalogue schema belongs to OR-E2; no tenant tables)
- Document commands in docs/guidence/try-it-locally.md

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Backend / Database
DEPENDENCIES: OR-002

TESTING CRITERIA:
- uv run alembic upgrade head succeeds on an empty PostgreSQL database (local TEST_POSTGRES_URL) and on the Supabase development project (POSTGRES_URL)
- uv run alembic downgrade base then upgrade head succeeds (baseline reversible)
- alembic check (or autogenerate dry run) reports no drift between models and migrations
- get_db() dependency closes sessions after request (test with a counter/mock)

EDGE CASES:
- Database unreachable during migration: clear error, non-zero exit, no partial state
- POSTGRES_URL using the Supabase default postgres:// or postgresql:// scheme: normalised to postgresql+psycopg://
- POSTGRES_URL pointing at the Supabase transaction pooler (port 6543): rejected with a message to use the session pooler or direct connection
- Password still wrapped in [ ] from the Supabase template, or unencoded special characters: clear authentication error that never prints the URL
- Direct connection host unreachable on IPv4-only networks: error message suggests the session pooler string
- Never use SQLite as a substitute in tests (dev/prod parity)

Scaffold the Next.js App Router frontend with strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, and the documented directory layout.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- frontend/ created with Next.js App Router, TypeScript (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess), ESLint, Tailwind CSS
- shadcn/ui initialised (components/ui/); add only primitives actually used
- Directory layout per frontend/AGENT.md: app/, components/{layout,product,search,filters,referral,ui}/, lib/{api,seo,utils}/, types/
- app/layout.tsx: html lang="en", semantic header/main/footer shell, site name, footer disclaimer: independent referral storefront, not the official Oriflame website
- app/page.tsx: minimal homepage shell (no catalogue data yet, no fake products)
- package.json scripts: dev, build, start, lint, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest run), test:e2e (playwright test)
- next.config: images.remotePatterns left empty until authorised image hosts are confirmed (OR-E2)

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-001

TESTING CRITERIA:
- npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build all pass
- Vitest: layout renders landmarks (banner, main, contentinfo) and the disclaimer text
- No NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable other than NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL referenced in source

EDGE CASES:
- Do not add mock product data to the homepage; any later mock data goes in an explicitly named dev fixture
- Do not use Oriflame logos or imply official affiliation in the shell
- Client Components only where interactive — the scaffold should contain none unless required

OR-E1.Summary: Typed API client and frontend-backend connectivity
OR-E1.Description:
Add a Zod-validated API client and prove the frontend and FastAPI backend communicate end to end.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- frontend/lib/api/client.ts: fetchJson(path, schema) using NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (server-side fetch from Server Components), explicit timeout via AbortSignal.timeout, typed ApiError
- frontend/lib/api/schemas/health.ts: Zod schema matching /health response
- Homepage (Server Component) or app/status/page.tsx (noindex) shows backend status using the client
- Errors render a graceful fallback, never a crash or raw error text

EFFORT: S (3 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Frontend / Backend
DEPENDENCIES: OR-003, OR-005

TESTING CRITERIA:
- Vitest: client returns parsed data for valid payload; throws ApiError on invalid schema, non-2xx, and timeout
- Playwright smoke: with backend running, status shows healthy
- Manual: both servers started via documented commands communicate (record in todo.md Review with evidence)

EDGE CASES:
- Backend down: page renders with 'service unavailable' state, HTTP 200 page shell, no stack trace
- Response with extra fields: tolerated by Zod (strip) but missing required fields rejected
- CORS: backend CORS_ORIGINS must include http://localhost:3000 in .env.example for local dev

Set up test infrastructure so every later task can add tests matching its TESTING CRITERIA.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:
- backend/tests/conftest.py: test Settings override (APP_ENV=test), PostgreSQL test database (from TEST_POSTGRES_URL), Alembic upgrade head once per session, transaction-rollback fixture per test, httpx AsyncClient fixture against create_app()
- backend/tests/{unit,integration,security}/ packages
- pytest-cov configured with fail_under=80 for backend/app
- frontend: vitest.config.ts (jsdom, Testing Library, @testing-library/user-event), coverage threshold 75%
- frontend: playwright.config.ts with webServer entries for frontend (and backend where practical); e2e/ directory with smoke spec
- Add TEST_POSTGRES_URL to .env.example

EFFORT: M (5 hours)
PROJECT AREA: Testing
DEPENDENCIES: OR-003, OR-004, OR-005

TESTING CRITERIA:
- uv run pytest runs all backend tests from OR-002/003/004 green with coverage report
- npm run test runs Vitest green with coverage report
- npm run test:e2e runs the Playwright smoke spec green locally

EDGE CASES:
- TEST_POSTGRES_URL missing: tests requiring DB fail with a clear setup message (not silently skipped)
- TEST_POSTGRES_URL equal to POSTGRES_URL: refuse to run (protect dev data)
- External network calls in tests: blocked/mocked — no test may hit Oriflame

Run backend and frontend verification gates plus dependency audits on every PR and push to the integration branch.

IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS:

- e2e job (optional/allowed-to-run where practical): Playwright smoke
- Workflow-scoped placeholder env values only; no real consultant code or referral URL in CI

EFFORT: M (4 hours)
PROJECT AREA: CI/CD
DEPENDENCIES: OR-007
